scope: Independent output-only blind assessment of iteration 5. Not formal review, whole-skill pass/fail or branch-readiness judgment.
rubric_notes: Judgment is based on observed content, not iteration budget, suite results, reference-read flags or optional gallery reading.
No arbitrary character limit or required output format. Familiar requests should remain proportionate; requested detail and necessary consent explanation justify length.
Both nonforced branch upload and PR must explicitly follow review and publication checks. Opt-out remains available until publication; merge is separate.
A valid missing-fact interview need not draft, seek confirmation or disclose publication yet.
Own-rule isolation is distinct from fixed-worker or identical-output requirements. Unknown affected counts do not authorize narrowing the requested invariant.

defect_classes.name: Unsupported narrowing of requested outcome scope
Internal workflow inventory or redundant presentation
Unnecessary required interview or shorthand clarification burden

material_findings.why: The supplied desired rule is that each job uses its own selection. The user did not restrict remediation to an identified current affected set. Preserving an unknown impact count does not justify narrowing the invariant or excluding currently unobserved cases. This creates a new outcome boundary under the guise of avoiding scope expansion.
